def kth_element(arr: list[int], k: int):
    """
    Return the k-th element of arr using 1-based indexing.
    
    Examples:
        kth_element([12, 3, 5, 7, 19], 2) -> 3
        kth_element([10], 1)              -> 10
    
    Raises ValueError if k is out of bounds (<= 0 or > len(arr)).
    """
    n = len(arr)
    
    # Validate k for 1-based indexing: must be between 1 and n inclusive
    if not isinstance(k, int):
        raise TypeError("k must be an integer.")
    if k <= 0 or k > n:
        raise ValueError(f"k={k} is out of bounds for array of length {n}.")
    
    # Convert to 0-based index and return the element
    return arr[k - 1]


# Example assertions
assert kth_element([12, 3, 5, 7, 19], 2) == 3
assert kth_element([12, 3, 5, 7, 19], 1) == 12
assert kth_element([12, 3, 5, 7, 19], 5) == 19
